content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question. What measurement error should I expect when connecting a 2-wire temperature sensor to the module with a cable length of 5 meters?

Hello, You can find the relevant information in the [product_name] manual: [url]. According to the documentation, the error limits are: 0 to +200°C: +/- 2°C, -50 to 0°C: +/- 3°C, based on the final measured value. Hope this helps.
Thank you, [user_name]. I found the information I was looking for.
